note: App AI machine-readable contract was not present at commit time. This file records backend-verified production schema availability and allowed deterministic merge rules implementable without App code changes.
census_feasibility_description: Reconstructable with deterministic historical aliases where stored in PostgreSQL. Perfect physical-phone truth is impossible when reinstall generates new device_id without durable linkage evidence.

package_android_id.notes: Stored as android_id column; maps to App package-scoped Android ID when App registers intelligence.

legacy_package_android_id.notes: Not persisted as dedicated column. Not available for census edges.

stable_hardware_id.notes: Widevine/stable hardware ID not stored in Admin PostgreSQL schema.

legacy_device_id.notes: Accepted on verify/register requests but not persisted as historical alias pairs for census reconstruction.

identity_candidates.notes: May appear inside metadata JSONB when App sends them; not indexed. Not used for census until App persists structured alias table.

migration_bridge_aliases.notes: No dedicated migration alias table. install_instance_id + android_id are only durable bridges.

allowed_edge_types.description: Two or more device_id values share the same non-empty install_instance_id in app_installs.
Two or three device_id values share the same valid android_id in device_intelligence_registry.
Exactly two device_id values share the same 64-char hex fingerprint in registry.

confidence_buckets.HIGH_CONFIDENCE_PHYSICAL_DEVICES: Component anchored by valid android_id OR merged by approved alias edge.
confidence_buckets.AMBIGUOUS_LOW_CONFIDENCE: Singleton device_id without android_id anchor in registry.
